title: Parties backend: schema and CRUD
objective: Party records exist as standalone tenant-scoped entities with CRUD, duplicate-name warning, optional region (Q-9), and no deletion (spec FR-26..FR-28 backend portion, PRD 12.9).
scope: Create/Update/Get/List endpoints with filters and type-ahead search
Non-blocking duplicate-name warning payload on create/update
out_of_scope: Lead counts on the list and /parties/{id}/leads (T-018, needs leads table)
implementation_details: Liquibase 080-parties: parties (tenant_id, id identity, name text not null, party_type_id bigint not null FK reference_items, segment_id bigint null, industry_id bigint null, region_id bigint null, is_strategic bool default false, contact_name text null, contact_email text null, contact_phone text null, last_activity_at timestamptz null, audit cols, PK (tenant_id,id)); trigram index on name for type-ahead (pg_trgm)

Features/Parties: CreatePartyCommand{Name (required, <=200, trimmed), PartyTypeId (required, active PartyType), SegmentId?, IndustryId?, RegionId? (optional per Q-9), IsStrategic, ContactName?, ContactEmail? (format), ContactPhone? (format)} -> returns {party, warnings:[{code:'DUPLICATE_NAME', matches:[{id,name}]}]} using case-insensitive similarity match against tenant parties; UpdatePartyCommand same shape/warnings; GetPartyQuery; ListPartiesQuery{search, partyTypeId, segmentId, industryId, regionId, strategic, sort, page} default alphabetical
No delete endpoint (PRD 12.9); reference values validated as active tenant items

FLAGGED FOR EVALUATOR: (1) DEVIATION from brief literal wording - foreign-tenant referenced segment/industry/region id returns 422 PARTY_INVALID_SEGMENT/INDUSTRY/REGION (SAME code as inactive/wrong-type), NOT literal 404; rationale: matches evaluator-approved T-012 Brokers precedent (BROKER_INVALID_BROKER_TYPE 422) and spec 14 groups reference-value-must-be-active-and-in-tenant under the 422 validation-catalog paragraph, not the 404-for-cross-tenant-path-ids paragraph; the F-035 security intent is fully met - foreign-tenant and invalid are byte-for-byte indistinguishable (proven by CreateParty_WhenForeignTenantReferencedRegion_ShouldReturnSameErrorAsAnInvalidRegion). (2) Contact phone regex ^[+]?[0-9()\-.\s]{7,20}$ - no spec-defined pattern exists (broker contacts only max-length), judgment call. (3) Sort only name/-name (no other fields specified). (4) Similarity thresholds 0.3/0.4 are product judgment calls. Full suite twice: Domain 10/10, Infrastructure 45/45, Api 179/179 = 234/234, 0 warnings/errors, no flakes. Handed to Evaluator.

Evaluation (iteration 1/10): VERDICT PASS, no findings. Independent suite (Docker live, no flakes): Domain 10/10, Infrastructure 45/45, Api 179/179 = 234/234. 422-vs-404 DEVIATION RULED ACCEPTABLE: spec 14 validation catalog enumerates 'reference values must be active and belong to the active tenant' as a VALIDATION rule (422 channel); the 404-for-cross-tenant clause governs the PRIMARY resource id in the path, not referenced body values; AC-065/FR-66 is decisive ('inactive or foreign-tenant reference values rejected with structured errors, nothing persists' = 422); T-012 BROKER_INVALID_BROKER_TYPE->422 precedent confirmed real; F-035 indistinguishability holds (IsActive*Async tenant-scoped so foreign-tenant id and nonexistent id both fail the same predicate -> same 422 + same code; the only body diff is the caller's own echoed input, not a leak). PATH-ID foreign access still correctly 404s (FindAsync explicit TenantId&&Id predicate -> PARTY_NOT_FOUND; Parties_ShouldBeTenantIsolated asserts both GET and PUT foreign -> 404). Tenant isolation via explicit TenantId predicates (F-020); duplicate-name genuinely non-blocking (party persisted 201 BEFORE FindSimilarByNameAsync; warning attached; tenant-scoped case/whitespace-insensitive). Schema conforming (identity PK, composite PK, LIST partition + default, registered in create_tenant_partitions, trigram GIN on parent, CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm idempotent, no EF/JSONB). 13 real integration tests meaningful/non-tautological (per-test Guid tenants, order-independent). Judgment calls all acceptable: phone regex (no spec pattern), sort name/-name (full sorting verified under AC-025/T-025 - advisory), thresholds 0.3/0.4+top-5 documented. Playwright parties.spec.ts legit test.fixme (Parties UI T-025). No existing test weakened. Recommend PASS.
